info.name: Salesforce Execute a Batch of Requests

items.docs: Executes up to 25 independent REST API subrequests in a single HTTP call. All requests are processed independently; failure of one does not affect others. Returns an array of results in the same order as the subrequests. Use this to reduce the number of round trips when making multiple unrelated requests.

info.name: Salesforce Execute a Composite Request With Dependent Subrequests

items.docs: Executes a series of REST API requests where later requests can reference the results of earlier requests using reference IDs. Supports up to 25 subrequests. If any subrequest fails and allOrNone is true, all changes are rolled back. Use this for complex multi-step operations where later steps depend on earlier results.

Creates up to 200 records in a single API call using SObject Collections. All records must be of the same or different SObject types. If allOrNone is true, all records must succeed or none are committed. Returns an array of save results with IDs or errors for each record.

Updates up to 200 records in a single API call using SObject Collections. Each record must include its ID and the fields to update. If allOrNone is true, all updates must succeed or none are committed. Returns an array of save results for each record.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of up to 200 record IDs to delete.

params.name: allOrNone
params.description: If true, all records must be deleted successfully or none are committed. Defaults to false.

items.docs: Deletes up to 200 records in a single API call using SObject Collections. Record IDs are passed as a comma-separated query parameter. If allOrNone is true, all deletions must succeed or none are committed.

params.name: sobjectType
params.description: The API name of the Salesforce SObject type (e.g., Account, Contact, Opportunity, MyCustomObject__c).

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of up to 2000 record IDs to retrieve.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of field names to return for each record. Returns all accessible fields if not specified.

items.docs: Retrieves up to 2000 records of the specified SObject type in a single API call. Record IDs are passed as a comma-separated query parameter. All records must be of the same SObject type. Returns all accessible fields for each record.
